text_block_list.text: Finally, it's time for the Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит is worried whether she
can inspire
people to dream in the same
way she herself was
inspired in the past.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, when she watches the live
broadcast
from the racecourse and sees
the fans cheering
for her, her fears melt
away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ready to answer their expectations, she
steps out
into the race she's always
dreamed of.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
